sentences.text:
The present petition has been preferred for the following relief/s:
(i) for issuance of an appropriate wit order or direction to the District Collector,
Supaul for fixation of the amount of award for acquisition of the land of petitioners for construction of Indo-Nepal Boarder Project in pursuant to provision made under section 21 and 26 of Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 hereinafter referred RFCTLARR Act, 2013 considering the proposal of land acquisition prepared adhering to section 12 by the requisitioning authority and the market- value as per the sale purchase through local Patna High Court CWJC No.14883 of 2017(4)
dt.08-07-2025 registry office and further give direction the nature of land mentioned at the time of requisition for acquisition can not be changed in arbitrary manner on the basis of a report of committees which has been not empowered under the Act to be constituted rather the authorities mentioned under the Act and document submitted by them can only be the basis for fixation of amount of award and compensation.
3.
A counter affidavit on behalf of respondent nos. 5 to 9 is on record.
According to which, the Collector, Supaul has already disposed of the objection of the petitioners on 09.10.2017.
4. It is to be noted that to acquire the land for Indo- Nepal Boarder Project, emergency provision was invoked.

5. Learned counsel for the petitioners submit that in that background, they have remedy under section 64 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

Granting said liberty and observing that if the petitioners prefers petition in next four weeks, the concerned Patna High Court CWJC No.14883 of 2017(4) dt.08-07-2025 authority shall take into account that the writ petition was pending before this Court while dealing with the limitation petition.
7.
The writ petition stands disposed of with the aforesaid observation.
8. Needless to add since it is an old matter after hearing the parties, the authority shall be taking the matter to its logical conclusion at an earliest.
9. Pending Interlocutory Application(s), if any also stand(s) disposed of.
